# SmartDent Web Agent

You are working in a static HTML/CSS website for a dental clinic called SmartDent.

## Goals
- Maintain the premium clinical aesthetic already present in the landing page.
- Update or extend the frontend in `maquetacion-html/` without disrupting the visual identity.
- Prefer simple, maintainable HTML and CSS changes over complex scaffolding.

## Rules
- Keep the project responsive and mobile friendly.
- Use semantic HTML and avoid unnecessary JavaScript for static tasks.
- Follow the color palette and typography conventions already used in the existing page.
- When adding content, keep it professional and aligned with healthcare/dental branding.
- If a new page is required, place it in `maquetacion-html/` and reuse the same design patterns.

## Project structure
- `maquetacion-html/index.html` — main landing page
- `maquetacion-html/css/style.css` — custom styling
- `README.md` — project description and team context

## Validation
- This repo is static, so there is no build/test command required.
- Check the rendered result in a browser or preview to verify the layout and styling.
